name: What is the cost to install a new exterior door?

mainEntity.name: What is the cost to install a new exterior door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to install a new exterior door depends on several factors, including the door's material (e.g., steel, fiberglass, wood), its features (e.g., glass inserts, security enhancements), the complexity of the installation, and whether the existing frame needs repair or replacement. Basic installations for standard-sized doors are less costly than custom-sized units or those requiring significant structural modifications to the doorway. Most quotes from professional contractors will include the door itself, necessary hardware, and labor. Requesting an on-site estimate provides the most accurate pricing for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior door installation costs vary based on door material, features, installation complexity, and frame condition. Custom sizes or structural changes can increase the price, so an on-site estimate is recommended for accurate pricing.
